summary: 'Sign slow' asks someone to slow down. It's a normal, polite request between signers and the single most useful phrase for a beginner.
steps: Sign SIGN: two index fingers circling alternately in front of you.
Sign SLOW: drag one flat hand slowly up the back of the other hand, from fingertips to wrist.
Keep a friendly, slightly apologetic face. Nobody minds this request.
note: Fluent signers ask each other to slow down all the time. Use it without embarrassment; what actually annoys people is nodding along when you didn't understand.
mistakes: Signing SLOW quickly. The movement should be as slow as the word.
